### 5.1 Hasten

|---|---|

| Immediate Movement | target moves up to Speed immediately, no action; cannot force illegal movement |
| Bonus Action Window | target may immediately take one listed Bonus Action |
| Reaction Refill | target regains Reaction if spent this round |
| Extra Reaction | target gains one additional Reaction before start of next turn |
| Evasion Beat | target gains Advantage or Time Die on one Dexterity save before start of next turn |

| Mode | Failed Save Effect |
|---|---|
| Halved Speed | Speed halved until start of target's next turn |
| Speed Locked | Speed becomes 0 until start of target's next turn |
| Reaction Denial | no Reactions until start of next turn |
| Bonus Action Denial | lose next Bonus Action |
| Action-Movement Split | on next turn choose Action or movement, not both |
| Delayed Effect | next effect resolves at end of current turn instead of immediately |
| Timing Penalty | next attack/save/check subtracts one Time Die |
| Hasten Interference | target cannot benefit from Hasten/Borrowed Action/Extra Action Window unless source wins Time Contest |

Successful save: no effect or halved duration.
